web_evidence.title: David Baldacci's The Christmas Train - Excerpt
web_evidence.note: The official Hallmark page reproduces Chapter One across five pages. Its sustained narration repeatedly names Tom Langdon and refers to him as 'he' while reporting his history, perceptions, motives, and plans, with no participating narrator.

person_note: The authorized opening is sustained third-person narration centered on Tom Langdon, and q00033 is directly situated within that excerpt. The interior Goodreads material corroborates the same pattern most clearly in q00037, while the other event fragments are too short or impersonal to diagnose independently. First- and second-person forms in the remaining quotations are local dialogue, not competing narrative sections. The label is THIRD; confidence is medium because the strong web excerpt covers only the opening and no credible whole-book structural description or authorized interior excerpt was found.
